# Large optional context

## Statement

The large optional unit MUST preserve its complete body when selected. This
fixture deliberately repeats meaningful context so its atomic bundle costs
more tokens than the later small candidate. Alpha beta gamma delta epsilon
zeta eta theta iota kappa lambda mu nu xi omicron pi rho sigma tau upsilon phi
chi psi omega. Alpha beta gamma delta epsilon zeta eta theta iota kappa lambda
mu nu xi omicron pi rho sigma tau upsilon phi chi psi omega.
